description: Free, no account needed. Search every ready-made asset three.ws publishes in one call: CC0 3D props and objects, rigged humanoid characters, and retargetable motion clips. Returns ids, titles, tags, licenses, and CDN urls, plus category facets to narrow the next query. Use this before generating anything: if the catalog already has the prop or character, dropping it in is instant and free where generating one is not. Feed a returned id to get_item_source for code that renders it on any site.

category.description: Exact category from a previous result's facets.

kind.description: Narrow to one library: object (CC0 props), character (rigged humanoids), animation (motion clips).

offset.description: Page offset. Use next_offset from the previous response.

q.description: Free text over titles, names, tags, and categories, e.g. "wooden chair", "office", "wave". Every word must match somewhere, so start broad.

tag.description: Exact tag from a previous result's facets.

name: search_catalog
title: Search the three.ws asset catalog
